page.overview:
What is Astronomy?

Astronomy is the Disc 1 eighth song from 1998's album Garage, Inc. It was written by Joe Bouchard, Albert Bouchard and Sandy Pearlman, with a length of 6:37.

The song was originally released by Blue Öyster Cult in 1974 on the Secret Treaties album. The Metallica version was recorded in Sep-Oct 1998 at The Plant Studios in Sausalito, CA.

The clock strikes twelve and moondrops burst Out at you from their hiding place Like acid and oil on a madman's face His reasons tend to fly away

Like lesser birds on the four winds, yeah Like silver scrapes in may Now the sands become a crust And most of you have gone away, then you're gone away
